profit_model_incomplete.title: Product profit model is incomplete
profit_model_incomplete.reason: The system cannot confirm whether delivery is profitable.
profit_model_incomplete.solution: Complete price and cost inputs, then recalculate the profit floor.
profit_model_incomplete.completion: Resolved when cost coverage and a valid profit floor are available.

target_roi_missing.title: Target ROI is missing
target_roi_missing.reason: The current platform target is unavailable.
target_roi_missing.solution: Enter target ROI and its data date for this product.
target_roi_missing.completion: Resolved after a valid target ROI is saved.

creative_supply_below_target.title: Creative supply is below target
creative_supply_below_target.reason: The test pool is smaller than the policy requirement.
creative_supply_below_target.solution: Add Winner variations and new candidates in the campaign creative workspace.
creative_supply_below_target.completion: Resolved when the pool reaches the policy minimum.

complete_days_below_target.title: Complete-day evidence is insufficient
complete_days_below_target.reason: The current period cannot support a safe change.
complete_days_below_target.solution: Sync reports and wait for enough complete delivery days.
complete_days_below_target.completion: Resolved when complete days reach the policy target.

orders_below_target.title: Order evidence is insufficient
orders_below_target.reason: Orders have not reached the decision threshold.
orders_below_target.solution: Keep one-variable settings and collect valid orders.
orders_below_target.completion: Resolved when orders reach the policy target.

roi_below_profit_floor.title: ROI is below the profit floor
roi_below_profit_floor.reason: Current delivery may be losing money.
roi_below_profit_floor.solution: Review costs and traffic quality, then approve one protected change.
roi_below_profit_floor.completion: Resolved after ROI recovers and observation passes.

net_profit_negative.title: Estimated net profit is negative
net_profit_negative.reason: Estimated profit after costs and refunds is below zero.
net_profit_negative.solution: Verify costs, then change only budget, creative, or offer.
net_profit_negative.completion: Resolved when estimated net profit is non-negative.

winner_missing.title: No winning creative is proven
winner_missing.reason: No creative meets both conversion and profit requirements.
winner_missing.solution: Run protected candidate tests in the creative workspace.
winner_missing.completion: Resolved after at least one Winner is verified.

three_profitable_days_required.title: Three profitable days are required
three_profitable_days_required.reason: Scaling requires three complete profitable delivery days.
three_profitable_days_required.solution: Keep settings unchanged and continue syncing.
three_profitable_days_required.completion: Resolved automatically after three qualified days.

seven_profitable_days_required.title: Seven profitable days are required
seven_profitable_days_required.reason: Steady operation requires seven profitable delivery days.
seven_profitable_days_required.solution: Keep the single-variable rule and continue observation.
seven_profitable_days_required.completion: Resolved automatically after seven qualified days.

campaign_binding_missing.title: Campaign binding is missing
campaign_binding_missing.reason: A valid account, store, or campaign binding is unavailable.
campaign_binding_missing.solution: Sync again and verify authorization and store binding.
campaign_binding_missing.completion: Resolved when the binding is restored.

campaign_disabled.title: Campaign is disabled
campaign_disabled.reason: Recovery performance cannot be verified while delivery is disabled.
campaign_disabled.solution: Confirm the disabled reason and readiness before recording the external change.
campaign_disabled.completion: Resolved after delivery resumes with fresh evidence.

delivery_data_stale.title: Delivery data is stale
delivery_data_stale.reason: The last delivery date is older than two complete days.
delivery_data_stale.solution: Sync reports and verify campaign state if data remains stale.
delivery_data_stale.completion: Resolved with delivery evidence from the last two complete days.

delivery_missing.title: No active delivery data
delivery_missing.reason: No spend or orders were detected.
delivery_missing.solution: Sync and confirm that the campaign is actually delivering.
delivery_missing.completion: Resolved after valid spend or orders appear.

product_budget_missing.title: Product budget is missing
product_budget_missing.reason: Product utilization and velocity cannot be calculated.
product_budget_missing.solution: Enter the product-level budget in supplemental data.
product_budget_missing.completion: Resolved after a valid budget is available.

intraday_spend_missing.title: Current-day spend is missing
intraday_spend_missing.reason: Current velocity cannot be compared with history.
intraday_spend_missing.solution: Enter intraday spend and its collection date.
intraday_spend_missing.completion: Resolved after valid intraday spend is available.

report_coverage_low.title: Report coverage is low
report_coverage_low.reason: Too many recent seven-day dates are missing.
report_coverage_low.solution: Sync reports and verify timezone and statistic dates.

mature_dormant_recovery.title: Mature-product recovery needs confirmation
mature_dormant_recovery.reason: Delivery is disabled, stale, or missing.
mature_dormant_recovery.solution: Verify inventory, costs, status, target ROI, and LIVE support.
mature_dormant_recovery.completion: Move to observation after readiness and delivery recover.

mature_diagnosis_required.title: Mature-product controls are incomplete
mature_diagnosis_required.reason: Coverage is too low for a safe write action.
mature_diagnosis_required.solution: Add product budget, intraday spend, and target ROI.
mature_diagnosis_required.completion: Write actions unlock at 80 percent coverage.

mature_velocity_constrained.title: Mature-product velocity is constrained
mature_velocity_constrained.reason: ROI is strong while budget consumption is low.
mature_velocity_constrained.solution: Review one product-budget change and observe three days.
mature_velocity_constrained.completion: Resolved when spend grows with stable ROI and conversion.

mature_scale_ready.title: Mature product is ready for controlled scaling
mature_scale_ready.reason: ROI and utilization meet the scaling gate.
mature_scale_ready.solution: Keep the profit track and complete three profitable delivery days.

mature_quality_decay.title: Mature-product traffic quality is declining
mature_quality_decay.reason: ROI declined or fell below the floor while spend continued.
mature_quality_decay.solution: Review traffic quality and approve only one protected action.
mature_quality_decay.completion: Resolved after ROI recovers and observation is stable.

mature_competitive_decay.title: Mature-product competitiveness is declining
mature_competitive_decay.reason: ROI and budget utilization are weakening.
mature_competitive_decay.solution: Repair either creative or offer, not both.
mature_competitive_decay.completion: Resolved after velocity and ROI recover.

mature_growth_ceiling.title: Mature product reached a growth ceiling
mature_growth_ceiling.reason: ROI is stable but GMV growth is limited.
mature_growth_ceiling.solution: Create second-generation creatives and expand traffic sources.
mature_growth_ceiling.completion: Resolved after new supply creates incremental growth.

mature_healthy_hold.title: Mature product is healthy
mature_healthy_hold.reason: No loss, anomaly, or scaling risk is active.

live_metrics_missing.title: LIVE conversion data is missing
live_metrics_missing.reason: LIVE UV, stay, click, or paid-order data is incomplete.
live_metrics_missing.solution: Complete the LIVE funnel fields for this instance.
live_metrics_missing.completion: Resolved after key LIVE metrics are available.

approval_pending.title: An adjustment is waiting for approval
approval_pending.reason: A protected action was created but not reviewed.
approval_pending.solution: Review values, evidence period, and profit floor, then approve or reject.
approval_pending.completion: Resolved after approval execution or rejection.

recommendation_failed.title: Platform adjustment failed
recommendation_failed.reason: The platform write did not complete or could not be verified.
recommendation_failed.solution: Review the error and audit. Retry only when no write occurred.
recommendation_failed.completion: Resolved after platform state and recovery are confirmed.

observation_active.title: A single-variable change is under observation
observation_active.reason: One intervention is active and other variables are locked.
observation_active.solution: Keep settings and sync three delivery days.
observation_active.completion: The system evaluates and keeps or rolls back after observation.

sync_interrupted.title: The previous sync was interrupted
sync_interrupted.reason: The application closed or lost the sync process.
sync_interrupted.solution: Review the last phase and retry the same sync.
sync_interrupted.completion: Resolved after a new sync completes.

external_campaign_setup.title: Confirm campaign setup and delivery mode
external_campaign_setup.reason: A new-product or LIVE start needs platform settings confirmed.
external_campaign_setup.solution: Confirm the campaign and Max Delivery setting, then record the actual value.
external_campaign_setup.completion: Observation starts after evidence is submitted.

external_delivery_mode.title: Confirm delivery mode
external_delivery_mode.reason: This stage requires a Max Delivery versus Target ROI check.
external_delivery_mode.solution: Change only delivery mode and record its actual value.
external_delivery_mode.completion: Three-day observation starts after evidence is submitted.

external_auto_budget.title: Confirm Auto Budget eligibility
external_auto_budget.reason: Auto Budget requires profitable days and complete support readiness.
external_auto_budget.solution: Verify inventory and LIVE support, then record the actual state.
external_auto_budget.completion: Three-day observation starts after evidence is submitted.

external_promotion_schedule.title: Configure promotion schedule
external_promotion_schedule.reason: Promotion delivery needs an explicit budget and date window.
external_promotion_schedule.solution: Configure the schedule and record the actual settings.
external_promotion_schedule.completion: Resolved after complete schedule evidence is submitted.

external_manual_intervention.title: Record a Seller Center single-variable action
external_manual_intervention.reason: This setting cannot be written through the current interface.
external_manual_intervention.solution: Change one variable as instructed and record the result.
external_manual_intervention.completion: Observation starts after actual value and evidence are submitted.
